### HTML forms (GET)  

::::: {.columns}

:::: {.column width=30%}

![](/http/html-form-get.png){fig-alt="Name: [Some Name] Query: [the thing to find!] [button: Submit]"}

::::

:::: {.column width=70%}
```
<form action="https://example.com/foo" method="get">
Name: <input type="text" name="name"><br>
Query: <input type="text" name="query"><br>
<input type="submit" value="Submit">
</form>
```
::::

:::::

 
```
GET /foo?name=Some+Name&query=the+thing+to+find%21 HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
...

```


### HTML forms (POST)  
::::: {.columns}

:::: {.column width=30%}

![](/http/html-form-post){fig-alt="Name: [Some Name] Comment: [A comment(newline)in(newline)several lines.] [button: Submit]"}

::::

:::: {.column width=70%}
```
<form action="https://example.com/foo" method="post">
Name: <input type="text" name="name"><br>
Comment:
<textarea name="comment">
</textarea>
<br>
<input type="submit" value="Submit">
</form>
```
::::

:::::
 
```
POST /foo HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Content-Length: 60
...

name=Some+Name&comment=A+comment%0D%0Ain%0D%0Aseveral+lines.

```


### HTML forms (multipart/form-data)  {.smaller}


```
<form action="https://example.com/foo" method="post"
    enctype="multipart/form-data">
    ...

```
<hr/>
```
POST /foo HTTP/1.1
Host: example.com
Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=---------------------------81545828010202052201987031310
Content-Length: 321
...

-----------------------------30871118663472832060210928793
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="name"

Some Name
-----------------------------30871118663472832060210928793
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="comment"

A comment
in
several lines.
-----------------------------30871118663472832060210928793--

```


### GET v POST

<table class="rowlines collines">
<thead><tr><th>GET</th><th>POST</th></tr></thead>
<tbody>
<tr><td>works with back button, caches</td><td>not resent automatically</td></tr>
<tr><td>limited by URL size</td><td>huge possible size</td></tr>
<tr><td>saving URL accesses page again</td><td>form info never ‘leaked’<br/> in browser history, referer, etc.</td></tr>
<tr><td>only simple text fields</td><td>supports file uploads<br/>(via multipart/form-data)</td></tr>
</tbody>
</table>
